routeChoices.label: Procession Road
routeChoices.description: Follow the old royal procession route toward the sentinel tomb.

routeChoices.label: Ossuary Descent
routeChoices.description: Descend through the ossuary and face more undead before the throne.

events.name: The Dead Answer
events.message: The royal names awaken. Crown Wraiths rise from the sealed alcoves.

royal_catacomb_sentinel: Royal Decree  -  free the marked player.
Tombfire  -  move from the burning seal.
royal_catacomb_king: Royal Decree - respond to the telegraph.
Crownfire - spread from other players.
Sepulchral Collapse - marked ground damage; move out.
King’s Chains - respond to the telegraph.
Unburied Retinue - summoned adds must be controlled.
King’s Bulwark - respond to the telegraph.
Crown Authority - respond to the telegraph.
Blood Soak Mythic - stack/soak with the party.
Watcher Tether Mythic - break the tether by managing distance.
Royal Arc Mythic - avoid the boss-facing telegraph.
